scripts.build: wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir pkg/web --out-name chess_core && wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node --out-name chess_core && rm -f pkg/web/.gitignore pkg/web/package.json pkg/node/.gitignore && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('pkg/node/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }) + '\n')"
scripts.ensure-build: (test -d pkg/node && test -d pkg/web) || pnpm run build
